answer: Weakest link: identity issuance, since minting a fresh agent costs nearly nothing. Bind each ID to a locked umber bond co-signed by an existing trusted agent, so a thousand sybils require a thousand distinct co-signers each risking real collateral. Break the co-signer gate and attackers still pay escrowed stake that decays per cluster, a velvet rope of shared cost: every duplicate dilutes reward until the fable turns to negative expected value.
